conventions.convention: The radiation chart has a_R>0 and T,s>0, with ε=a_R T⁴, p=ε/3 and s=4a_R T³/3. It contains no particle-number or chemical-potential coordinate and assigns no empirical value to a_R.
The radiation calculation uses signature (−,+,+,+), g(u,u)=−c², stress T^{ab}=(h/c²)u^a u^b+p g^{ab}, and Minkowski length coordinate x⁰=ct. The linear velocity perturbation is w^i=δu^i/c.

C, κ, τ, T₀ and L are strictly positive. Spatial derivatives are Euclidean derivatives, using periodic lifts on T_L³. The specified quadratic effective entropy is distinct from a nonlinear material entropy, and e_L is a positive quadratic Lyapunov density rather than physical energy density.

Global evolution and norm contraction use the draft constant-coefficient supplier conditionally, with countable choice, componentwise Schwartz or smooth periodic data, negative-sign 2π Fourier normalization, and torus coefficients normalized by L⁻³. Forward contraction is asserted for t≥0.
The explicit mode uses n≥1, k=2πn/L, strict underdamping k²>C/(4τκ), and 0<|Θ|<T₀. It solves the PDE for all real time, while its positive-temperature bound is asserted for t≥0.

load_bearing.statement: For real smooth solutions of Cθ_t+div q=0 and τq_t+q=−κ∇θ with positive coefficients, the specified effective entropy satisfies ∂_t s_eff+div j_s=|q|²/(κT₀²), and e_L=(Cθ²+(τ/κ)|q|²)/2 satisfies ∂_t e_L+div(θq)=−|q|²/κ. The principal eigenvalues are zero twice and ±√(κ/(Cτ)); global evolution, contraction and finite propagation follow conditionally from the stated draft supplier. The stated strict periodic small-data bound ensures T₀+θ>0 for t≥0.
Fix a real parameter a_R>0 and T∈(0,∞). Define ε_T(T)=a_R T⁴, p_T(T)=a_R T⁴/3, s_T(T)=4a_R T³/3, and τ(s)=(3s/(4a_R))^(1/3) for s>0, with ε_s(s)=a_R τ(s)⁴ and p_s(s)=ε_s(s)/3.

The temperature and entropy coordinates are inverse, dε_T=T ds_T, h_T=T s_T, and dp_T/dε_T=1/3 on T>0. Under the stated smooth Lorentzian geometry, countable choice, velocity normalization and perfect-stress conservation, ∇_a(su^a)=0. The specified Minkowski rest linearization has transverse zero eigenvalues twice and longitudinal eigenvalues ±c/√3; its global PDE conclusions remain conditional on the exact draft symmetrized-system supplier.

alerts.finding: In the Statement, 'the exact mathematical interface in [F1]' points to the global evolution clause, but F1 records only entropy and Lyapunov identities; the global interface is F3. The periodic small-data sentence likewise points to F1 for K and the norm although F3 records that supplier use. The proof uses the appropriate facts, so these are internal reference-label defects.
